{{Quote|I've heard enough. The Stromma council will not risk its warriors in this mad attack. Particularly not an attack against our allies. I hereby withdraw all of them from Imperial service, effective immediately.|Nyama, to Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Nyama''' was an aggressive [[Stromma]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Stromma council]]'s [[Stromma Council Liaison|liaison]] to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Empire of the Hand]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he met several Imperial [[Commanding officer/Legends|officers]] aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' over the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], where [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] was hiding.

Nyama and his [[Nyama's conciliator|conciliator]] discussed the [[Quesoth Soldier]]s within Quethold's [[Red City]], as well as the [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] also talked about the [[Battle of Oristrom|battle]] of the Stromma [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Oristrom]], which the Stromma was winning before Esva assumed command. After Thrawn presented a dangerous [[Attack on the Red City|battle plan]] of an attack on the Quesoth, Nyama withdrew the Stromma forces from the Empire of the Hand. During the battle, Esva told Quesoth [[bowlcarrier]] [[Trevik]] of the Grand Admiral's ability to learn someone's strategy by studying their art, declaring it true after the Stromma Council Liaison discovered it aboard the ''Admonitor''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|And all this against Quesoth Soldiers? You have far too much confidence in your humans, Admiral Thrawn.''"<br />"''The stormtroopers of the 501st consist of humans and nonhumans. ''[&hellip;]'' Including a number of your own people.''"<br />"''Not anymore. ''[&hellip;]'' I've heard enough. The Stromma council will not risk its warriors in this mad attack. Particularly not an attack against our allies. I hereby withdraw all of them from Imperial service, effective immediately.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama and Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
[[File:Admonitor-EaW.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Admonitor'']]
The [[Stromma]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Nyama was the [[Stromma council]] [[Stromma Council Liaison|liaison]] to the [[Empire of the Hand]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> After he and his Stromma [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] arrived at the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' aboard several [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] and [[Nyama's shuttle]], the liaison and his [[Nyama's conciliator|conciliator]] met several Imperial [[Commanding officer/Legends|officers]] during a strategy session. Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] discussed [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s remaining [[Nuso Esva's realm|forces]] and the Empire's future [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]], where the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]] lived, with Nyama, who shared information on the Stromma [[Expansion Period|wars]] against the Quesoth. Thrawn then requested a recording of Esva's [[Painting/Legends|artwork]] within the [[City/Legends|city]], and Nyama gave a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] to several [[Treason/Legends|traitorous]] Quesoth to record the art.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

After receiving the recordings, which were recorded by [[bowlcarrier]] [[Trevik]], who carried a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for the Quesoth [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], the liaison translated some phrases spoken in the [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]] [[Language/Legends|language]] before Thrawn promised victory by sending [[Human/Legends|Human]] Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to fight [[Quesoth Soldier]]s, which prompted Nyama to withdraw all Stromma from Imperial service, as he deemed the Humans unfit to defeat the Soldiers. Although his conciliator attempted to stop him, his forces indeed left the ''Admonitor''. During the battle between Esva's forces and the Empire of the Hand, the warlord and the Quesoth [[Queen of the Red|Queen]] informed Trevik that Nyama was able to confirm that Thrawn could determine an enemy's strategy by studying their art. The alien also told the bowlcarrier that the artwork recorded under Nyama's directive was there to mislead Thrawn, who would strategize according to the paintings, allowing Esva to defeat him; however, the Grand Admiral expected such a plot, and changed his strategy halfway into the battle, defeating the warlord.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But they're still loyal, aren't they? ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''I said they can think for themselves. ''[&hellip;]'' Are you deaf, you bald-skinned-|Stormtrooper Commander Balkin and Stromma Council Liaison Nyama discuss the Midli|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
While in the strategy session, Nyama and Balkin discussed the [[Midli]] and [[Circling]] Quesoth castes, and the former established they were loyal to their [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] and could think by themselves. When Balkin asked if they were loyal, the impatient Stromma insulted him before his conciliator stopped him. An arrogant and aggressive Stromma, Nyama was quick to anger and an ally of the Queen of the Red.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nyama appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
